title: Hazeel Cult
start: Talk to Sir Ceril Carnillean in his mansion in south-west Ardougne.

rewards.t: 2005 coins coins (5 coins coins from the first part and 2000 coins coins for the second part)
Mark of Hazeel and Carnillean armour (obtained during quest depending on which side you choose and by using the drop trick, but both can be claimed from the Quest Item Storage at May's Quest Caravan)
Can talk to Historian Minas at the Varrock Museum to receive 5 Kudos

steps.t: Talk to Ceril Carnillean, located in his house to the immediate south of the East Ardougne castle. [Chat: 1 What's wrong? › Accept]
Exit his house and make your way to the south side of it.
There are five valves that must be turned, complete them on the way to the cave to save time later:

sub.t: Valve 2 is directly behind the Carnilleans' house. Turn it right.
Valve 1 is west of the clock tower, just across the bridge. Turn it right.
Valve 3 is north of the cave, east of the clock tower. Turn it left.
Valve 4 is just south of Ardougne Zoo's penguin cage. Turn it right.
Valve 5 is south-east of the fourth valve, near Brother Cedric. Turn it right.

steps.t: Enter the cave entrance that is south of valve 3.
Pick a side and follow the guide for the according side.
Talk to Clivet and refuse to help - he will disappear. [Chat: 1 What do you mean? › 1 I will never help you.]
Board the raft.
Go south and talk to Alomone, and then kill him.
Pick up the Carnillean armour he drops.

sub.t: To get a second piece of armour, kill Alomone again. (You may have to drop the armour before killing Alomone.)
Before talking to Ceril to turn in the quest, drop one on the floor, he will take any you have in the backpack. If you bank it, it will be gone after.

steps.t: Return to Carnilleans' house and talk to Ceril.
You will get a kind of "Quest Complete!" notification, but there is one more step.
Go upstairs and search the wardrobe in the eastern room, on the southern wall.
Quest complete!
Talk to Clivet and agree to help. [Chat: 1 What do you mean? › 2 So, what would I have to do? › 2 Okay, count me in.]
Go to the basement of Ceril's house and use the bottle of poison on the range.
Talk to one of the Carnilleans.
Return to the cave entrance.
Board the raft.
Go south and talk to Alomone.
Return to the Carnilleans' house.
Search the crates in the basement for a chest key.
Exit the basement by heading up the ladder, and go upstairs.
Knock on the odd wall which is the north wall in the north-west room.
Climb the ladder and unlock the chest to get the Hazeel scroll.
Return to Alomone and talk to him to give him the scroll. A cutscene will play.
Quest complete!
